query_template: Update the investment thesis in the uploaded memo: see the files attached to this turn. Parse it into pillars, assumptions, milestones, scenarios/price targets, and falsifiers (inferring falsifiers if absent, labeled as inferred); establish the memo's as-of date; build a dated ledger of every material development since — prints and guidance, estimate revisions, filings, management changes, competitive and macro events, and price action vs benchmark; map each development to the thesis element it confirms, weakens, or breaks; rule each pillar intact/strengthened/impaired/broken and the overall thesis on track, drifting, or falsified with anti-anchoring and thesis-creep checks; and deliver a redline-style delta memo with refreshed milestones, falsifiers, and a monitoring plan. Ticker (if the memo is ambiguous): {{ticker}}. Memo as-of date override: {{as_of_date}}. Preferred data source: {{data_source}}. Output format: {{output_format}}. {{additional_context}}

pages.title: Which thesis needs updating?
pages.description: Upload your memo — every dated development since gets mapped to the pillar it confirms or breaks

fields.label: Existing thesis or memo
fields.accept_description: PDF, Word, Markdown, or text files

fields.label: Ticker
fields.placeholder: e.g., MSFT, ASML, V — leave blank to auto-resolve from the memo

fields.label: Memo as-of date override
fields.placeholder: e.g., 2025-03-15 — leave blank to detect from the memo
fields.description: Developments are tracked from this date to today. Defaults to the date on the memo, or the latest dated datapoint inside it.

fields.label: Additional context
fields.placeholder: e.g., We added to the position in June — stress-test the margin pillar hardest. Or: focus the update on the two prints since the memo.

fields.label: Data sources
fields.description: Select every data provider you want this run to draw on. Providers you have not connected are skipped gracefully and noted, so connecting them enriches the output. Perplexity Finance is always available.

options.label: Perplexity Finance (built-in)
options.description: Always available — live quotes, financials, estimates, transcripts, macro data

options.label: FactSet
options.description: Consensus estimates, fundamentals, ownership, M&A — requires connected FactSet

options.label: Daloopa
options.description: Analyst-grade historical fundamentals and KPIs with filing citations — requires connected Daloopa

options.label: Morningstar
options.description: Fundamentals, fair values, fund and ETF data — requires connected Morningstar

options.label: PitchBook
options.description: Private company rounds, valuations, cap tables, sponsor M&A — requires connected PitchBook

options.label: Carbon Arc (alt data)
options.description: Alternative data: demand and transaction signals to corroborate or challenge reported KPIs — requires connected Carbon Arc

options.label: Guidepoint (expert calls)
options.description: Expert interview transcripts: customers, competitors, former employees — requires connected Guidepoint
